judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a recognizable grey dolphin with a streamlined body, dorsal fin, and tail fluke.
Show a water surface below the dolphin with a large splash effect at the point where the dolphin has exited the water.
Position the dolphin in a dynamic jumping arc, with its entire body in mid-air.
requirements.note: The tail stock and fluke are drawn well below the water surface line, inside the blue water, so the body is not entirely in mid-air.

requirements.text: Draw a circular, multi-colored hula hoop, and position the dolphin so its mid-section is passing through the center of the hoop.
requirements.note: The hoop is a single flat orange colour with no second colour anywhere on the ring, so it is not multi-coloured.

requirements.text: Include a human trainer's arm and hand extending into the frame.
The trainer's hand must be holding a small fish by the tail.
The dolphin's mouth must be depicted as wide open, just about to bite the body of the fish being held by the trainer.
requirements.note: The snout is drawn closed - a smooth grey beak with a white underside and no gape - although the fish is held at its tip.
